content:
Maya: FYI I flipped the allocator shim that changes the slotspill hint generation for paged attention. Noticed a small perf regression on P90 for long sequences (8k+).
Jon: Can you paste the exact numbers? Is it KV cache miss related?
Maya: Microbench (1 card, A100, bf16) before: 6.2 ms/token P50, 18.5 ms/token P90. After: 6.3 ms P50, 21.2 ms P90. Throughput -2.5% on batch size 8.
Sasha: Hmm that P90 jump smells like extra page faults during slot reclaim. Did the shim change eviction ordering?
Maya: Yes, the shim adds an eviction hint that favors contiguous blocks for compaction. It trades occasional wider scans for fewer small fragments. Implementation:
```
// alloc hint: prefer_adjacent = true
if (prefer_adjacent && candidate.span > 1) assign_span(candidate);
else assign_single(candidate.idx);
```
Jon: That code looks fine. Are we deferring reclamation IO to the caller thread? That could cause latency spikes.
Maya: We are reusing the pager IO thread but the hint causes larger, synchronous merges in the critical path when a hot slot spans pages.
Harry: Could also be batching heuristic interaction — larger merges increase per-request latency if batch steering picks small batch windows. Did you correlate with batch size distribution traces?
Maya: Yes. When batch sizes are small (<4) we see higher P90; larger batches hide it. Telemetry: shard=0 batch-dist: 60% size 1-3, 30% 4-8, 10% >8.
Sasha: Short-term mitigation: add async compaction and a cap on synchronous merge length. Also tune batch steering to prefer slightly larger windows when eviction activity detected.
Jon: Agreed. Also add a fast-path that skips contiguous-span merges for requests that are latency-sensitive (token deadline < 10ms).
Maya: I pushed a quick patch to the slotspill branch that caps sync_merge_len=64 and makes compaction async. Deploy-bot: rolled patch to canary on dev pool-3.
deploy-bot: canary rollout started for commit 823f9c7 on dev-pool-3 — 3/3 hosts healthy.
Harry: Early canary numbers look promising, P90 back to 18.9ms on the same bench. Need more runs and strain tests.
Sasha: Please add a small perf regression unit that runs daily: seq lens 2048/4096/8192 with batch mix and records kernel choice + page faults.
Maya: Added perf job and a telemetry probe that emits `evict_hint` + `sync_merge_len` per reclaim. Will watch for regressions and notify #eng-releases.
Jon: Thanks — once stable we should document the tradeoffs in the paged-attn design doc (eviction-hint section) and mention batch-steering interaction.
Maya: Will update doc and open a follow-up RFC for alternative heuristics (span scoring, age-weighted eviction). :+1:
Sasha: Nice. Closing this loop after 24h canary and perf job passes.
